question: Is the Mojeek Search API Personal tier (1 query a second, 2,000 queries a day) still sold, and should the corpus hold a record for it?
why: The Wayback Machine captures of the API page read for 2025-01-19 to 2026-04-26 list a first tier of 1 Query /sec and 2,000 Queries /day; those read for 2026-05-27 to 2026-10-01 and the current page list Startup, Business and Enterprise only. A vendor forum reply of 2025-08-28 says standard API prices are GBP 1, GBP 2 and GBP 3, and a reply of December 2025 says to sign up for the Personal plan to claim credits, while the current FAQ says to sign up for the Startup plan. A third-party article (bodnar.cz, read 2026-11-01) calls the one-pound tier the Personal plan. No dossier record covers a Personal tier.
